properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: 1.7 GW renewable energy programme
properties.description: Financing an estimated 100 km of power transmission lines to be built by private renewable energy developers in the context of Tunisia's 1.7GW concession regime tender, including 650MW solar end wind energy.
milestones: Tender award. (EBRD)

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: 320 MW increase of renewable energy production
properties.description: The project will focus on the implementation of mini-grids in rural areas in the South and West of Madagascar.
milestones: Signature of contribution agreement for rural electrification with AFD

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Bio2Watt plants expansion in South Africa, Mozambique and Uganda
properties.description: Bio2Watt is a waste to value project in South Africa, which will expand to Mozambique and Uganda. Bio2Watt plants treat animal waste and other waste sources to reduce biogas. This creates a biobased energy source, captures and limits methane emissions and reduces the pollution of water resources.
properties.location_name: the Commission's point for Africa, in Chad
milestones: Planned expansion of the South Africa plant to 9.8MW. Extension of the project to Mozambique and Uganda would lead to communication events in these countries marking these developments.

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Cleanup of Hann Bay (Dakar)
properties.description: Construction of a wastewater treatment plant and the pre-treatment of the waste from the most polluting industries along the Bay.
milestones: Inauguration of the wastewater treatment plant

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Climate adaptation and resilience in Africa
properties.description: Mobilisation of investment and insurance schemes and solutions for climate resilience in Africa.
properties.location_name: the Commission's point for Africa, in Chad

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Coastal Protection Beira
properties.description: Beira, Mozambique, faces multiple coastal threats. Employing tailored nature-based solutions can mitigate risks, safeguard livelihoods, and protect the vital Beira port, a key transport link to Malawi, Zambia, and Zimbabwe.
milestones: Tendering and start project

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Coastal protection Togo
properties.description: This flagship project consists in supporting urgent coastal protection efforts in Togo through a Grant Arrangement signed with the Ministry of Finance of Togo, under the World Bank-led WACA program.
milestones: Milestone 2024: start of construction (contract will be signed in 2023).

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Construction and development of the Kigali Wholesale Market
properties.description: Enhance quality and safety of agricultural products and boost market-system efficiency and post-harvest infrastructure in Kigali, including infrastructure and management, and improve access to local and regional urban markets, promoting gender-sensitive and sustainable high-value product chains.
milestones: Final agreement on the financing architecture of the project

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Construction of 85 MW solar PV plant combined with electrolysers
properties.description: The EU and EIB are looking to support a project that will set up an 85 MW solar park relying on trackers and a green hydrogen unit based on electrolysers, fuel cells, and battery storage. The objective is to see the solar panels powering electrolysers to produce hydrogen that can be stored.
milestones: Signature in the context of planned EIB operations

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Construction of Kakono Hydropower Plant
properties.description: Kakono comprises an 88MW plant with fish pass and an associated transmission line. It will be a major power generation asset in the highly productive northwest of Tanzania. Kakono plant will increase the energy injected into the interconnected grid and will have a stabilizing impact on the grid.
milestones: Signature of Agreement with AFD

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Construction of National Control Centre for Energy Infrastructure, improvement of the reliability and sustainability of the power supply
properties.description: The project will support the monitoring and controlling of the transport of electricity in the country, the enhancement of the capacity of the grid and the digital transformation of the electricity sector (installation of the optic fibre included).
milestones: Selection of the Owner Engineer
Launch of tender process for the works

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Construction of Pump and Storage Facility in Santiago island
properties.description: A sovereign framework loan to the Republic of Cabo Verde to finance a set of inter-related electricity generation, transmission and storage projects under the country's National Electricity.

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Construction of Ruzizi III hydropower plant for the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Rwanda and Burundi
properties.description: The project is part of the Africa-EU Green Energy Initiative which aims to engage European and African public and private sector actors to increase electricity production and access to energy, promote energy efficiency, support reforms for boosting private investment, and foster market integration.
properties.location_name: the Commission's point for Africa, in Chad
milestones: Launch of studies
A joint TEI trip to Tshopo province is planned with the Development Cooperation Heads of the Embassies, to visit several activities in the regions and to launch the TEI at the university of Kisangani

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Construction of about 150 small photovoltaic-hybrid mini-grids
properties.description: The mini-grids with a total PV capacity of 15 MWp are expected to directly benefit about 54,000 households and 6,000 SMEs, providing initial electrification or substituting polluting and more expensive diesel-generated electricity supply.
milestones: Potential signature of EIB loan

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Construction of the Nachtigal hydroelectric dam (400 MW)
properties.description: The hydroelectric power plant (420MW) will produce more than 2100 GWh yearly. As a renewable source of energy, the power plant will contribute to avoiding the emission of 850kteq of CO2 per year.
milestones: Signature (first tranche) expected

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Critical raw materials (CRM) Partnership Roadmap
properties.description: Implementation of the strategic partnership with Zambia to promote the development of sustainable raw materials value chains.
milestones: Signature of MoUs and Signature / Endorsement of CRM Partnership Roadmap

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Development of generation and evacuation infrastructure for on-grid renewable energy projects Construction of six small hydropower plants of a total of approximately 2MW
properties.description: The project is part of the Africa-EU Green Energy Initiative which aims to engage European and African public and private sector actors to increase electricity production and access to energy, promote energy efficiency, support reforms for boosting private investment, and foster market integration.
milestones: Signature of Financing Agreement

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Development of solar power plant in Boundiali and Serebou and Extension, reinforcement and upgrading of networks
properties.description: The project will contribute to the low carbon transition by increasing the production and access to more electricity from renewable energy sources.
milestones: Inauguration of 37.5 MW grid connected solar plant (Boundiali, north part of the country)

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Doubling the capacity of the desalination plant, construction of a solar energy plant
properties.description: Expansion of the desalination plant to double its capacity, and construction of a solar energy plant to fully power the plant, including related PV plant and water treatment infrastructure.
milestones: Signature of EIB Finance Agreement with the Government in 2023

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: ELMED Electricity Interconnection
properties.description: Constructing a 200 km long submarine high voltage electricity cable interconnection between Italy and Tunisia to develop cross-border electricity trade and reduce CO2 emissions by more than 200 tonnes a year.
milestones: 2023 (Q2): project proposal -to support the renewable energy part approved at NIP Board
During Q2-2023, launching ceremony in Tunis with donors (KfW, BM, EIB, EBRD)

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Eastern Backbone Power Transmission
properties.description: A new 132 kV line will be constructed to replace the now unreliable 42-year-old wooden pole-mounted lines, which serve important domestic, agro-based industries, mining and rural growth centres. The project will enable the transmission of exclusively green energy with a new energy efficient system.
milestones: Signature financing agreement with government Q4 2024

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Energy efficiency of buildings in the Mediterranean region
properties.description: The project aims to address technical barriers and the cost of energy efficient construction or renovation to support energy efficiency and climate resilience in buildings such as schools and health facilities.
properties.location_name: the Commission's point for Africa, in Chad
milestones: Inauguration of the 1st rehabilitated building Q4 2024

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Expansion of the Gabal Asfar Wastewater Treatment Plant
properties.description: Enhancing capacity of the wastewater treatment plant to treat an additional 1 million m3 of disposed water, develop a new sorce of water for standard agriculture and forestry uses, reduce dependence on fossil fuels to run the plant.
milestones: Start of construction work Q2 2024

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Financial platforms for green hydrogen in South Africa and Namibia
properties.description: This flagship project consists in supporting the launch of Green Hydrogen economies in developing countries and emerging markets, with a focus on South Africa and Namibia. The project aims to enable long-term energy resilience, industrial development, and inclusive green growth in Southern Africa.
properties.location_name: the Commission's point for Africa, in Chad
milestones: Investment commitments to 4 projects in the green hydrogen value chain in South Africa
Formal investment commitments to 4 green hydrogen production projects in Namibia
Several fundraising milestones in 2024

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

properties.description: Building a 950 km long submarine cable to connect the Egyptian and Greek powrer systemsfor the transfer of clean electricity produced in Egypt from renrwable sources.
milestones: The project promoter, ELICA, a member of Kopelouzos Group, is expected to complete the project’s feasibility study within 2023 and is currently evaluated by the European Commission regarding its potential statues as a PCI project

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Green and Sustainable Industries Programme
properties.description: Providing concessional loans and grants to private and public companies for investments in pollution abatement, decarbonisation and sustainable industry practices.
milestones: Official launch of the programme

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: High voltage transmission line (backbone)
properties.description: The project consists in the construction of a 541 km 400kV high voltage transmission line connecting Greater Abidjan with substations in the East and North of Côte d’Ivoire and with the regional interconnectors to Burkina Faso and Mali.

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: High-tension electric interconnection line between Nouakchott and Kiffa
properties.description: The overall objective is to stimulate the increase in solar energy production capacities and universal access to electricity in Mauritania, through the deployment of high-tension electricity networks.
milestones: Contract signature between the EIB and Mauritanian government (loan and grant)

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Implementation of partnership on raw materials value chains and renewable hydrogen
properties.description: The project aims to create or strengthen Green Hydrogen and Sustainable Critical Raw Materials value chains in Namibia as part of the EU-Namibia strategic partnership. The initiative will be reinforced by investments in a strategic regional transport corridor, linking Maputo-Gaborone-Walvis Bay.
milestones: Development of roadmap with concrete actions

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Improving access to electricity in Bujumbura
properties.description: The project is part of the Africa-Europe Green Energy Initiative which aims to increase electricity production and access to energy, promote energy efficiency, support reforms for a conducive regulatory environment for private investment, and foster market integration.
milestones: Signature of agreement with EIB is foreseen for Q2 2025

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Improving and securing electricity generation
properties.description: Enhance and secure renewable electricity generation in DRC by rehabilitating the Ruzizi II hydropower plant and upgrading the common switchgear for hydroelectric power plants INGA I and II.

properties.description: The project will support the development of a bauxite mine in the area of Nyinahin with a target to achieve an annual mining production of 5 Μt as well as the development of an Alumina Refinery with processing capacity of 1.5 Mt alumina.

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

properties.description: Rehabilitation of 350 km of canals along the Shabelle and Juba river to boost sustainable, nutrition-focused agri-food systems and enhance key value chains like sesame and sorghum.
milestones: Q4 2024 First Somali international conference on agricultural value chains and investment opportunities
Q2 2024 completion of the irrigation canals assessment

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Irrigation programme PARIIS and rural development programme PADAER II
properties.description: The PARIIS programmes aims to improve the capacity of stakeholders to develop and manage irrigation and increase the surface areas irrigated. The goal of PADAER II is to contribute to reducing rural poverty, stimulate economic growth and create sustainable jobs for rural people.
milestones: Tender and Financial Agreement Signature

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

properties.description: Build a 50-100 MW public solar power plant at Gwiwa, Jigawa state, to de-risk the sector for private investment (construction of evacuation lines, storage, institutional technical assistance, etc.)
milestones: The grant agreement was signed in autumn 2023 and will finance the feasibility study
2nd half of 2024: AFD financing for the project implementation phase
End 2024: completion of the project feasibility study

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Just Energy Transition Partnership
properties.description: Complementary interventions in strategic value chains to support the Just Energy Transition through hard infrastructure, as well as soft measures in the areas of SMEs development, skills, research and innovation, technology transfer and policy strengthening.

Launch of the infrastructure IIPSA (Infrastructure Investment Programme for South Africa) grants
Signature and launch of the grants (Annual Action Plan 2023) to support SMEs, expand TVET opportunities and reinforce state capacity
Signature of the loan framework agreement between EIB and South Africa; the EIB Board is expected to approve the loan in mid-November.

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP)
properties.description: Boost renewable energy deployment, targeting 40% of Senegal's electricity capacity by 2030.
milestones: Finalisation of the long-term strategy (LTS) for low greenhouse gas emission development

By July 2024, definition of an investment plan, by Senegal, in liaison with the members of the group of international partners, to identify the opportunities to implement its fair and equitable energy transition.

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: KOLWEZI SOLWEZI interconnector
properties.description: Construction of a 148 km long, high-voltage direct current (HVDC) 330kV transmission line to boost the stability of Zambia Electricity Supply Corporation Limited and National Electricity Company networks, particularly in southern Democratic Republic of Congo.

milestones: Signature of Contribution agreement with the AfDB

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

properties.description: The overall objective is the rehabilitation works of the 160 MW Kpong hydroelectric dam to ensure the availability of green electricity in Ghana and the safety of the dam and of the population surrounding the dam.

Start of activities and preparatory work on the project

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Medlink: decarbonizing North Africa and EU energy sector
properties.description: The project consists in developing around 10 GW of renewable energy in Algeria and Tunisia, producing 30 TWh/year for local use and export, plus 4 GW of new electricity transfer capacity between North Africa and Europe. It aims to cut about 8 MtCO2/year in the EU and accelerate the energy transition.
properties.location_name: the Commission's point for Africa, in Chad
milestones: Preliminary site-survey (on/offshore) and for solar/wind measurement campaign
Signature of multi countries agreement (EU, Nord Africa)in support of Medlink project
Completion of Engineering Basis of Design
Enviromental Social Impact Assessment Study (ESIA)

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Modernisation of two hydropower plants
properties.description: Modernisation of two hydropower plants and their extension by solar technology.

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

milestones: Signature (first tranche) expected

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

properties.description: The project supports biodiversity conservation in six priority regions: Congo Basin forest ecosystems, Transhumance landscapes in Central Africa, West Africa Forests, Sudano-sahelian savannahs of West Africa, Eastern Rift savannahs and watersheds, Transfrontier conservation areas of Southern Africa.
properties.location_name: the Commission's point for Africa, in Chad

Publication of preliminary studies regarding the NWFE energy track
Dialogue between Team Europe actors and Egyptian Authorities on application of pledge

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Olkaria I & IV Uprating project

It provides access to finance for promising early-stage initiatives, helping them to grow into scalable projects resilient to the effects of climate change.
properties.location_name: the Commission's point for Africa, in Chad
milestones: Water Facility will have final financial close at 1 BN USD

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

Targeted and multi-stakeholder training workshops
Expansion of the smart irrigation system to additional selected farms

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

properties.description: YAS will support 10,000 young people in setting up their own business in the agri-food sector or finding a suitable job. Launch of NL combi-tracks solar energy and horticulture, bringing together aid, trade and investments and also connecting renewable energy and agri-food.
milestones: Signing a partnership contract between TomatoJos (major tomato paste processor), First City Monumental Bank and HortiNigeria (NL program).
Launch of our Youth in Agribusiness (YAS!) programm.

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects
properties.name: Rehabilitation and expansion of drinking water infrastructure

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

properties.description: Deployment of a broadband backbone using electricity transport lines' fiber optics to lease to telecom operators, fostering competition and diversifying revenue for grid expansion, and support to Ethiopian Electric Power's human capacity development, and integration of renewables into the grid.

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

Signature FA with the Government of Zambia

Formalization of the credit agreement/act of signature

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

Development of a scoping report regarding the SouthH2Corridor
Preparation of a Common Declaration of Political Intent with Tunisia and Algeria

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

This project could help the negotiation of a strategic partnership between DRC and the EU

properties.source: European Commission, Global Gateway flagship projects

Three loans disbursed throught the Italian Government
Leveraging from additional financial sources; inclusion of public-private partners

Signature of the loan with the beneficiary
Signature of EU Contribution Agreement with LFI

Opening of the Kivu-Kinshasa Green Corridor: Launch of a pusher boat on the Congo River
Book Virunga '100 Years of Africa's First National Park'

MoU and feasibility studies for rail line expansion (Luacano, Angola to Chingola, Zambia)
